typeof type guard.description:
TS 1.0
typeof type guard
Narrows a union type by runtime-checking a primitive's `typeof` tag (`'string'|'number'|'boolean'|'bigint'|'symbol'|'function'|'object'|'undefined'`).

instanceof type guard.description:
TS 1.0
instanceof type guard
Narrows a union type by runtime-checking the value's prototype chain.

in type guard.description:
TS 2.7
in type guard
Narrows a union of object types by checking whether a given property key exists on the value at runtime.

custom type predicate.description:
TS 1.6
function isType(value): value is Type
A user-defined type guard — the `value is Type` return annotation tells the compiler to narrow the argument's type wherever this function returns `true`.

discriminated union.description:
TS 2.0
discriminated union
A union of object types sharing a common literal-typed tag property (here `kind`); switching on the tag lets the compiler narrow each branch automatically.

assertion function.description:
TS 3.7
function assertIsType(value): asserts value is Type
Instead of returning a boolean, an assertion function narrows the argument's type for the rest of the enclosing scope after it's called (throws if the assertion fails).
